Plugin.Name: DockTail
Plugin.Overview: DockTail watches Docker containers, reads docktail.* labels, and exposes matching containers as native Tailscale Services — HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, TLS-terminated TCP and Funnel — without giving each app its own Tailscale device. Requires the Tailscale plugin and a tagged Unraid node. DockTail is developed by marvinvr (https://github.com/marvinvr/docktail); this plugin packages it for Unraid.
